identity_and_theme.vibe: High-end fashion editorial meets digital atelier and creative studio. Dark room + blood-red lighting + liquid chrome objects + massive editorial typography.

typography.headline_font: Cormorant Garamond, Playfair Display, or Bodoni Moda (Serif / Editorial Display)
typography.subheading_font: Syne, Clash Display, or Cabinet Grotesk (Wide Modern Display Sans)
typography.body_font: Inter, IBM Plex Sans, or Plus Jakarta Sans (Clean functional body)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono or Space Mono (Technical metadata, coordinates, stamps)

hierarchy_rules.h1_hero: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-8xl tracking-tight font-serif uppercase leading-[0.9]
hierarchy_rules.h2_section: text-3xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tighter uppercase text-[#F1EDE5]
hierarchy_rules.h3_card: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-sans tracking-wide uppercase text-[#F1EDE5]

typography.editorial_typography_effects: Massive overlapping screen text ('CHOOSELESS' / 'EDITORIAL CULT') with overflow-x-hidden, subtle parallax on scroll, and text-fill translucent gradients (#F1EDE5 to #7A0010).

layout_and_spacing.bento_grid_mode: MODE A: TETRIS GRID (Asymmetric, tension-filled layout)
layout_and_spacing.section_flow: HEADER -> EDITORIAL HERO -> METALLIC 3D CANVAS / SHOWCASE -> FEATURED PROJECTS (HOVER BLOOD-RED LABELS) -> SOCIAL / CONTENT STUDIO WALL -> ABOUT / PHILOSOPHY -> VISUAL CONTACT FORM -> EDITORIAL FOOTER
layout_and_spacing.hero_overlay_rule: Maximum overlay bg-black/40 with gradient from #080808 via transparent to #7A0010/20. Let images and chrome renders breathe.

custom_cursor.default: Small 8px solid Bone White dot with smooth spring trailing ring

hover_states.project_item: Expands to blood-red 80px circle containing uppercase label 'VIEW'
hover_states.social_media_card: Expands to crimson glow ring with 'PLAY'
hover_states.cta_button: Magnetic lock-on interaction with radial crimson aura

motion_and_interactions.section_transitions: Brief red flash / crimson ambient glow on section intersection; smooth Lenis scroll momentum.
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: 1px chrome borders shift to blood-red glow (#7A0010); images scale 1.05 with saturation shift; text shifts to italic Cormorant Garamond.
motion_and_interactions.metallic_simulation: CSS specular highlights, radial gradients moving with cursor position (`bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_var(--mouse-x)_var(--mouse-y),#7A0010_0%,transparent_60%)]`), brushed metal noise texture overlays.

key_sections_definition.hero: Full viewport height. Oversized interactive typography overlaying liquid chrome 3D simulation canvas. Ambient blood-red cursor radial spotlight.
key_sections_definition.projects_showcase: Asymmetric editorial list and bento cards. Hovering project title triggers large floating image preview with blood-red text and gunmetal tags.
key_sections_definition.social_content_wall: High-energy horizontal scroll / mosaic masonry wall featuring reel previews, social content cards, video clips, and stacked editorial compositions.
key_sections_definition.about_studio: High-contrast two-column editorial split. Left: High fashion studio portrait in dark room. Right: Minimal philosophy, statistics, and press citations.
key_sections_definition.contact_form: Minimalist visual form with gunmetal input cards, blood-red focus rings, magnetic send button, and mocked success overlay state.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='contact-form-submit', data-testid='project-card-01').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.js_files_rule: This project uses .js/.jsx files. Do not use TypeScript type annotations.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop: Never center-align the app container. Use aggressive asymmetry, generous spacing (p-12, p-20, p-32), subtle grain texture, and high-contrast typography.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.header_bg: Header must use backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#080808]/80 with 1px border-b border-[#242426] and z-50. Never fully transparent.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.hover_contrast: Ensure explicit hover text color. Example: hover:bg-[#7A0010] hover:text-[#F1EDE5].
